status: isolated account/revision-bound cache storage draft; coordinator and app integration absent
implementation: uses existing Personal ProfileStateStore and ready marker; account, revision, enabled and erasure state checked on owner sequence
stores opaque model JSON inside bounded profile/account envelope using atomic writer; POSIX no-follow read
does not return a different account cache; write is private to future trusted coordinator
refuses overwrite of corrupt, wrong-profile or unreadable prior cache
verified: real synthetic files survive reopening a new ProfileStateStore instance
account replacement denies stale read and stale commit without changing old file; new account sees missing
pending erasure blocks read and commit; corrupt file remains unchanged; symlink is refused and target preserved
private profile denied; Unicode escape text preserved; unauthorized commit rejected at compile time
limitations: model JSON is opaque and commit trusts its native coordinator; future coordinator must validate returned model output and bind account/revision before calling
not connected to model runner, Profile service, network, renderer or real profiles; no cross-process restart, power-loss, account rollback or concurrent external writer qualification
profile state operations and cache commits must all run on one MayBlock owner sequence; no cross-process lock or descriptor-bound parent validation
Windows deliberately refuses cache reads pending handle/reparse qualification; Linux runtime untested
encryption-at-rest, shipping cache migration, full size/large-cache compatibility, production permissions and cross-platform acceptance remain open
